axes.plusLine: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared: plans, snacks, calendars.
axes.minusLine: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.

h.plusLine: You feel most yourself when life is shared with the people close to you.
h.minusLine: You love deeply and keep room of your own. For you, closeness includes space.
h.plusKnow: For you, closeness is something you share. The same plans, the same table, the spare key: that's how you show love.
h.minusKnow: You can miss someone and still need an evening alone. That time isn't distance. It's how you come back to people whole.
h.flexKnow: You choose closeness person by person. With some you share everything, with others you keep a little room, and it serves you well.

axes.plusKnow: Your love has logistics. Shared calendars, the spare key, the group order. For you, close is something you do together.
axes.minusKnow: You can miss someone and still want the night to yourself. That isn't distance. It's how you come back full.
axes.flexKnow: Some people get the spare key, some get a very warm wave. You decide person by person, and you're rarely wrong.

axes.plusLine: You say the hard thing to their face, because that's how you show respect.
axes.minusLine: You hold the person first. The hard part waits for a gentler moment.

h.plusLine: You say difficult things directly, because to you that is a form of respect.
h.minusLine: You look after the person first and choose a gentle moment for the hard part.
h.plusKnow: You name hard things early. It can read as blunt, and it comes from care: you'd rather no one gets hurt later.
h.minusKnow: You can bring difficult news gently. People come away feeling held rather than hurt, and many never learn how to do that.
h.flexKnow: You choose your words by who is in front of you. Gentle with some people, plain with others.

axes.plusKnow: You say the hard thing early so nobody walks into a wall later. People call it blunt. It's actually care.
axes.minusKnow: You can deliver hard news so softly that people thank you for it. Most people never learn that.
axes.flexKnow: Soft with some people, straight with others. You pick the tone for the person, not the moment.

axes.plusLine: Traditions, rituals and the way a home should run feel like home to you.
axes.minusLine: You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

h.plusLine: Traditions and familiar rituals give your relationships and your home their shape.
h.minusLine: You shape love, home and celebrations in your own way rather than following a script.
h.plusKnow: Your rituals tell people they belong. The same song at birthdays, the same seat at dinner.
h.minusKnow: You shape life in your own way. Your home, your holidays and your relationships follow the usual way only when it fits.
h.flexKnow: You keep the traditions that still mean something. The rest you let go, gently.

axes.plusKnow: Rituals are how you tell people they belong. The same song at every birthday, the same seat at every dinner.
axes.minusKnow: You treat how it's always been done as a suggestion. Your home, your holidays, your love life: all custom builds.
axes.flexKnow: You keep the traditions that still mean something and quietly retire the rest. Curated, not rebellious.

axes.plusLine: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
axes.minusLine: New city, new plan, new try. The unknown pulls you in.

h.plusLine: You value security, and you take chances once your footing is solid.
h.minusLine: You're drawn to the unfamiliar, and new places and plans feel inviting to you.
h.plusKnow: Your biggest steps rest on quiet preparation. People rarely see that part, so they call it luck.
h.minusKnow: A fully mapped plan leaves you a little restless. You would rather find out than know in advance.
h.flexKnow: You can feel which season you're in. Some call for certainty, and some for the unknown.

axes.plusKnow: Your boldest moves come after the boring homework. Nobody sees the prep, so everyone thinks you're lucky.
axes.minusKnow: A plan that's fully mapped bores you a little. You'd rather find out than know in advance.
axes.flexKnow: Some days you want the sure thing, some days the unknown. You can tell which day it is, and you follow it.

axes.plusLine: You want visible wins and a clear direction, sooner rather than later.
axes.minusLine: You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.

h.plusLine: You want progress you can see and a clear direction to move in.
h.minusLine: You move at your own pace and don't measure your life by other people's timelines.
h.plusKnow: You like to see that you're getting somewhere. A finished list, a goal reached, a door that opened because you kept going.
h.minusKnow: Your timeline is your own. You've stepped out of a race you never chose, and it shows in how steady you are.
h.flexKnow: You know when to push and when to rest. You work hard when it matters and ease off when it doesn't.

axes.plusKnow: You like proof you're getting somewhere. A finished list, a goal ticked off, a door that opened because you kept pushing.
axes.minusKnow: You've stepped out of a race nobody signed you up for. Your timeline is yours, and it shows in how calm you are.
axes.flexKnow: You can sprint when it matters and coast when it doesn't. Knowing which is which is the real talent.

axes.plusLine: A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.
axes.minusLine: You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

h.plusLine: You trust a fair, consistent process, because it treats everyone the same.
h.minusLine: You look at the person and the situation, and you let rules bend when someone needs it.
h.plusKnow: Fairness matters to you in the details. You'll hold a line even when it's uncomfortable, because it protects everyone.
h.minusKnow: You look at the situation before the rulebook. When a rule is hurting someone, you start looking for another way.
h.flexKnow: You follow the rules until a person matters more. Then you choose the person, and you're at peace with it.

axes.plusKnow: Fair is how you keep people safe. You read the fine print, and you'll hold the line even when it's awkward.
axes.minusKnow: You judge the situation, not the rulebook. If a rule is hurting someone, you're already looking for the side door.
axes.flexKnow: You follow the rules until a person matters more. Then you choose the person, and you sleep fine.

relationship.name: Ride-or-Die
relationship.desc: You're in it with your people all the way, and you'll tell them the truth on the way in. Your loyalty is loud, honest and done your way.
relationship.sting: You'll go to war for your people. Letting them go to war for you is the part you haven't practiced.
relationship.heart: I'm all in, and I tell the truth. You get both.
relationship.read: You're the one who shows up first and tells the truth once you're there.

h.desc: You stay close to your people and speak honestly with them, and you build those bonds on your own terms rather than on anyone's template.
h.read: You're the one who stays, and who tells people what they need to hear.
h.sting: You defend the people you love without hesitation. Letting them stand up for you is harder, and it's allowed.
h.heart: My loyalty and my honesty come together, and I trust both.

relationship.name: The Glue
relationship.desc: You're your group's center of gravity. You make the plan, make the call and keep the traditions running, and somehow everyone ends up at your table.
relationship.sting: Everyone leans on you. Very few people have thought to ask if you're tired.
relationship.heart: I can carry it all, and I deserve to be carried too.
relationship.read: You're the one who keeps everyone together, and everyone knows it.

h.desc: You hold your people together. You make decisions, keep traditions alive and bring everyone back to the same table, often before anyone asks.
h.read: You're the one who holds people together, often without being asked.
h.sting: Many people rely on you. Fewer think to ask how you are, and you're allowed to want that.
h.heart: I carry a lot for the people I love, and I can let them carry me too.

relationship.name: Golden Retriever
relationship.desc: You love out loud. Warm, gentle and all in, you decide for yourself what closeness looks like, and nobody around you ever wonders if they're wanted.
relationship.sting: You make room for everyone's feelings in real time. Yours tend to come up a week later, casually.
relationship.heart: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.
relationship.read: You're the one who makes everyone feel like the favorite, and means it every time.

h.desc: You love openly and gently, and you shape closeness in your own way rather than by anyone's rulebook. People feel welcome around you without having to earn it.
h.read: You're the one who makes people feel welcome before they have said a word.
h.sting: You make space for everyone's feelings as they happen. Your own often wait until later, and they deserve the same room.
h.heart: I let my warmth show, and I don't apologize for how much I care.

relationship.name: Comfort Person
relationship.desc: You're the saved seat, the leftovers packed to go, the birthday nobody forgets because you didn't. Feelings and traditions are both safe with you.
relationship.sting: You notice the second anyone is off. People rarely notice when you are, because you make it look easy.
relationship.heart: Being someone's safe place is my favorite job.
relationship.read: You're the one people call when they need to feel okay again.

h.desc: You protect the feelings and rituals that make people feel at home: the familiar meal, the message on the right day, the seat kept for someone running late.
h.read: You're the one people turn to when they need to feel settled again.
h.sting: You notice quickly when someone is struggling. Others notice your struggles less, partly because you carry them so quietly.
h.heart: Being a safe place for the people I love matters to me, and I let it.

relationship.name: Lone Wolf
relationship.desc: You're yourself first in every relationship. Your boundaries are said out loud, your script is written by you, and the people who stay really stay.
relationship.sting: You rarely get hurt. That's partly because very few people get close enough to try.
relationship.heart: Being my own person is how I stay me in every room.
relationship.read: You're the one who needs nobody's permission, and still picks your people carefully.

h.desc: You stay yourself in every relationship. You say where your limits are and shape your life by your own design, and the people close to you know exactly who they're with.
h.read: You're the one who stays true to yourself, whoever is in the room.
h.sting: You are rarely hurt, partly because few people get close enough. Letting one or two more in could feel different than you expect.
h.heart: Knowing my own mind is how I stay close to people without losing myself.

relationship.name: Straight Shooter
relationship.desc: You say what you mean and you like things done properly. The classic way makes sense to you, and the final call on your life stays with you.
relationship.sting: The truth comes out of you easily. Telling someone you need them takes a lot longer.
relationship.heart: Plain words are how I show respect.
relationship.read: You're the one who says it plainly, and people trust you because of it.

h.desc: You speak plainly and value doing things the established way, while keeping the final say over your own life.
h.read: You're the one who speaks plainly, and people trust you for it.
h.sting: Honesty comes easily to you. Saying that you need someone comes more slowly, and it counts just as much.
h.heart: Speaking plainly is how I show people respect.

relationship.name: Free Spirit
relationship.desc: Gentle voice, clear line, and a life you'd rather write yourself than copy from a template. You're easy to be around and hard to steer.
relationship.sting: People take your easygoing side as the whole story. They find the rest when they cross a line you never announced.
relationship.heart: I can be gentle and still go my own way.
relationship.read: You're the one who's easy to be around and impossible to put in a box.

h.desc: You're gentle with people and firm about your own path. You would rather shape your life yourself than follow a template, and you do it quietly.
h.read: You're the one who moves gently and still goes exactly your own way.
h.sting: People often see only your easy side. Your limits are real too, and saying them sooner would help the people who love you.
h.heart: I can be gentle with people and still follow my own path.

relationship.name: Old Soul
relationship.desc: You love the cozy, familiar kind of life, you speak gently, and you still need hours alone behind your own door. Quiet is where you recharge.
relationship.sting: Some people read your need for quiet as distance. You've never quite explained that it isn't.
relationship.heart: Love with a little space is still deep love.
relationship.read: You're the one who feels most like yourself on a quiet night at home.

h.desc: You're drawn to a calm, familiar life. You speak gently, you value long-held ways of doing things, and you need real time alone to feel like yourself.
h.read: You're the one who feels most yourself in quiet, familiar places.
h.sting: Some people read your need for quiet as distance. You haven't always explained that it isn't, and they would understand.
h.heart: I love deeply, and space is part of how I do it.

life.name: The Planner
life.desc: You want big wins, and you like the steps to them mapped, checked and done properly. Your calendar is a love letter to future you.
life.sting: You hit the goal and start the next list before you celebrate this one.
life.heart: Big goals, small steps. Every one of them counts.
life.read: You're the one with a plan, a backup plan and a date for both.

h.desc: You aim high and build toward it carefully, one checked step at a time, and you like knowing the ground under each step is solid.
h.read: You're the one who turns big goals into clear, steady steps.
h.sting: You often reach a goal and move straight to the next. The one you just reached deserves a moment too.
h.heart: I build my life one careful step at a time, and every step counts.

life.name: The Slow Burner
life.desc: You're climbing, quietly and on purpose. You know when to take the side road, and you'd rather not bet the safety net to get there.
life.sting: You'd love the recognition. You'd just rather nobody saw you wanting it.
life.read: You're the one quietly getting further than anyone realizes.

h.desc: You're building something steadily and without fuss. You adapt when a situation calls for it, and you keep your footing while you climb.
h.read: You're the one making steady progress that few people see yet.
h.sting: You would like your work to be seen, and you rarely let yourself ask for that. Asking is allowed.
h.heart: My ambition is quiet, and it's still mine.

life.name: Creature of Habit
life.desc: Your days run on routine and order, and you're in no rush to prove anything to anyone. Same café, same walk, same excellent choice.
life.sting: Your life is so steady that some nights you wonder what the other version would have looked like.
life.heart: I chose my ordinary days. I didn't settle for them.
life.read: You're the one whose ordinary days are exactly how you like them.

h.desc: Your days follow a rhythm you've chosen, with an order you trust, and you don't feel a need to prove yourself on anyone else's timeline.
h.read: You're the one who has made a calm, familiar rhythm your own.
h.sting: Your life is steady, and some nights you wonder about the other paths. Wondering is curiosity, not regret.
h.heart: I chose the rhythm of my days, and I'm glad I did.

life.name: The Easygoer
life.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, you like the flow familiar, and you're usually the calmest person in the room.
life.sting: People mistake your calm for not caring. You just haven't found the thing worth rushing for yet.
life.heart: My life doesn't need a progress bar.
life.read: You're the one who stays calm while everyone else is rushing.

h.desc: You move at your own pace, adjust easily to what each day brings, and prefer the comfort of the familiar. People tend to relax around you.
h.read: You're the one who helps everyone around you slow down a little.
h.sting: People sometimes read your calm as not caring. You care; you just haven't found what is worth rushing for.
h.heart: My life doesn't need a finish line to feel full.

life.name: The Strategist
life.desc: You jump, but only after scouting the landing, packing a plan B and reading the fine print. Bold moves, tidy math.
life.sting: You'd rather lose on a plan than win on luck. It keeps a few great gambles off your list.
life.heart: Bold and careful. I get to be both.
life.read: You're the one who takes the big leap with the landing already mapped.

h.desc: You're drawn to new ground and big goals, and you prepare for them thoroughly: you study the terrain, set up a fallback and follow a clear method.
h.read: You're the one who takes real risks, and plans each one thoroughly.
h.sting: You would rather lose with a plan than win by luck. That keeps a few worthwhile chances off your list.
h.heart: I can be bold and careful at the same time.

life.name: The Go-Getter
life.desc: You want something big and you'll trade certainty to get it. The route is negotiable. The mission isn't.
life.sting: You'd rather regret doing it than not. Now and then the bill for that arrives, and you pay it quietly.
life.heart: Even if I lose, I get a great story.
life.read: You're the one who goes for it while everyone else is still talking about it.

h.desc: You pursue big goals and accept uncertainty along the way. You adapt the route whenever it helps, and you keep your eyes on where you're going.
h.read: You're the one who moves toward what you want before the path is clear.
h.sting: You would rather regret trying than regret waiting. Sometimes that costs you, and you tend to carry it alone.
h.heart: Going after what I want is worth it, however it turns out.

life.name: The Explorer
life.desc: You chase the new, skip the main quest and still live by a personal code nobody can talk you out of. Wide map, firm compass.
life.sting: You've been a lot of places. You rarely tell anyone where you're headed next, sometimes including yourself.
life.heart: Curiosity is my map. My values are my compass.
life.read: You're the one who wanders far and always knows your own lines.

h.desc: You're curious about the new and unhurried about getting anywhere, and you carry a clear personal code with you wherever you go.
h.read: You're the one who explores freely and keeps your values close.
h.sting: You've been to many places and rarely say where you're heading next. People would like to come along, even just in conversation.
h.heart: I explore freely, and my values travel with me.

life.name: The Wanderer
life.desc: You follow your curiosity wherever it goes. Rules and timelines are suggestions, and the moment decides.
life.sting: Freedom is your superpower. Now and then it's also your favorite way out of a hard conversation.
life.heart: I travel light, and I live true.
life.read: You're the one who lets curiosity pick the route, and it usually picks well.

h.desc: You let curiosity guide you. You treat plans and rules as flexible, and you trust the moment to show you what comes next.
h.read: You're the one who trusts curiosity and the moment to lead the way.
h.sting: Your freedom means a great deal to you. Sometimes it is also an easy way to step around a hard conversation.
h.heart: I travel light, and I live by what feels true to me.

believePlus.fun: You're all in with your people, and you still keep a room that's only yours. That little door is how you keep showing up.
believePlus.heart: You are devoted to your people, and you also keep a space that is only yours. That space is part of how you stay close.

believeMinus.fun: Here's what people miss about you: all that independence has a switch. The second your people need you, you're already on your way.
believeMinus.heart: What people often miss about you is how fast your independence gives way. When someone you love needs you, you are already on your way.

believePlus.fun: When someone you love is hurting, the honest part can wait a minute. You lead with a hand on the shoulder, then say the true thing.
believePlus.heart: When someone you love is hurting, you let the honest part wait. You offer comfort first, and the truth follows when they can hear it.

believeMinus.fun: Your quiet superpower: gentle almost all the time, then one clear sentence exactly when it counts. People carry that sentence for years.
believeMinus.heart: Your gentleness has a spine. When something truly matters, you say it clearly, and people know they can lean on your word.

believePlus.fun: From the outside you look like a keeper of tradition. Up close, your own life runs on rules you wrote yourself.
believePlus.heart: From the outside, you look like someone who keeps tradition. Up close, the choices that shape your own life are entirely your own.

believeMinus.fun: Your secret rule: rewrite everything, except the handful of rituals that make a place feel like home. Those stay exactly as they are.
believeMinus.heart: There is a rule you live by without naming it. You reshape almost everything, but a few familiar rituals stay, because they make a place feel like home.

believePlus.fun: You check the exits, read the reviews, pack the spare charger. Then a real door opens, and you're the first one through it.
believePlus.heart: You prepare carefully and like to know where you stand. When a real opportunity opens, you step through it sooner than most people would guess.

believeMinus.fun: The secret behind every leap you take is a soft place to land. You chase the new thing and keep a way home, which is why you keep leaping.
believeMinus.heart: Your sense of adventure rests on something steady. You move toward the new while keeping solid ground behind you, and that is what lets you keep going.

believePlus.fun: Your version of winning has a secret clause: free time. You'll chase the goal hard, but your own hours are the part you never trade.
believePlus.heart: Your idea of success includes time that belongs only to you. You work toward your goals, and you protect those hours as part of the win.

believeMinus.fun: The calm is real, and so is the fire. It just waits for a goal that's actually yours, then shows up all at once.
believeMinus.heart: Your calm is real, and so is your drive. It waits for a goal that genuinely matters to you, and then it shows up in full.

believePlus.fun: You're the one who keeps things fair, and also the one who quietly makes the exception when someone you love needs it. Both come from the same place.
believePlus.heart: You care about fairness, and you can see when a person needs an exception. For you, both come from the same place.

believeMinus.fun: Underneath all that go-with-the-flow is a firm line. When fairness is really on the table, you want it done properly, for everyone.
believeMinus.heart: Beneath your flexibility is a firm sense of fairness. When it truly matters, you want the same clear rules to apply to everyone.

We·Soft·Own.fun: People tell you things they haven't told anyone else. Something about you makes the truth feel safe to say.
We·Soft·Own.heart: People tell you things they have not said anywhere else. Something in the way you listen makes honesty feel safe.

We·Soft·Classic.fun: You're the one who remembers the coffee order, the pet's name, the hard anniversary. That's why your place feels like home.
We·Soft·Classic.heart: You remember the small details about people. That quiet attention is much of why they feel at home with you.

We·Direct·Own.fun: Nobody has to decode you. People always know where they stand, and that's exactly why they relax around you.
We·Direct·Own.heart: No one has to guess with you. People know where they stand, and that lets them settle.

We·Direct·Classic.fun: When the plan falls apart, heads turn toward you. By then you usually have the next step lined up.
We·Direct·Classic.heart: When things get hard, people look toward you. More often than not, you already know the next step.

Me·Direct·Own.fun: You don't need a crowd to know who you are. People trust you for exactly that reason.
Me·Direct·Own.heart: You know who you are without anyone confirming it. People find that steadying to be around.

Me·Direct·Classic.fun: Your word is the rare kind that holds. Say you'll be there, and people stop worrying, because you will be.
Me·Direct·Classic.heart: Your word holds. When you say you will be there, people stop worrying and plan around it.

Me·Soft·Own.fun: Your quiet superpower: you give people room to be exactly themselves, because you know what that room is worth.
Me·Soft·Own.heart: You give people room to be themselves. You know how much that room is worth, because you need it too.

Me·Soft·Classic.fun: Your calm is contagious. People leave time with you feeling lighter and can't quite say why.
Me·Soft·Classic.heart: Your calm settles the people around you, often without them noticing where it came from.

Steady·Push·Rules.fun: You finish what you start. It sounds simple, and it's the reason people quietly build their plans around you.
Steady·Push·Rules.heart: You finish what you start. People rely on that more than they say.

Steady·Push·Context.fun: Plans change and you just reroute. The goal stays in sight the whole time, even when the path doesn't.
Steady·Push·Context.heart: When plans change, you adjust without losing your direction. The path moves and the goal stays.

Steady·Easy·Rules.fun: Your routines are a home base other people borrow when their week goes sideways, more often than you'd guess.
Steady·Easy·Rules.heart: Your steady rhythm gives others something to lean on when their days feel unsettled.

Steady·Easy·Context.fun: You make a rough day feel smaller just by walking into the room.
Steady·Easy·Context.heart: Your ease makes hard days feel more manageable for the people near you.

Venture·Push·Rules.fun: Big ideas look doable around you, because you've already sketched steps one, two and three.
Venture·Push·Rules.heart: Ambitious ideas start to feel possible around you, because you can already see the steps.

Venture·Push·Context.fun: Things start happening once you're in. Your momentum is the push other people were waiting for.
Venture·Push·Context.heart: Your momentum helps other people begin. Things tend to move once you are part of them.

Venture·Easy·Rules.fun: You can land anywhere and still be completely yourself by the first morning.
Venture·Easy·Rules.heart: Wherever you go, you stay recognizably yourself, and that makes new places feel a little less new for the people with you.

Venture·Easy·Context.fun: You notice the detour everyone else walked past, and it usually turns out to be the best part.
Venture·Easy·Context.heart: You notice the possibilities other people pass by, and they are often the best part of the way.

Circumstance, Not my life, No recent example and Skip never count. '(slight)' means strength 1. The strings describe the evidence; the scored values live on the card options in chapters/*.final.json, and the strings are synced from the cards after card edits.

tagRules.genderNeutral: No he/she/媽/他/她 in names or lines; the friend game inserts the owner's pronouns.
tagRules.dropped: Q03 (a woman publicly choosing traditional roles) and Q07 (sex before commitment) feed no tag. Q02 is removed from T15 and rebuilt as an everyday rule card in T25.

tags.line: Your phone is an open book, and you like it that way.
tags.sting: Sharing everything feels easy to you. It stings a little when someone you love keeps a locked door.
tags.heart: Letting you all the way in is how I feel safe.
calls: You've handed someone your unlocked phone to pick the music, and didn't hover.

h.heart: Letting people all the way in is how I feel close to them.

You've quoted the actual rule in a board game argument.
You've waited for the walk signal on a completely empty street.

h.line: You believe fairness means the same rules apply to everyone.
h.sting: You rely on clear rules partly because you aren't sure people will be fair without them.
h.heart: Clear rules make me feel safe, not restricted.
